title: Time-Division Multiplexing: The Operational Rhythm and Temporal Organization Layer of Digital Life
abstract: arXiv:2611.06603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual agents must handle urgent interaction while retaining alternatives, replaying errors, and committing safe long-term changes. A previous digital-life framework distinguishes online (busy) and offline (idle) channels, but leaves open whether these are separate programs or phases of a common process and how their operations should be ordered. Motivated by recent observations of rapidly alternating perceptual representations in primate cortex, we develop a temporal organization layer with phase-tagged micro-epochs, an observable duty cycle, independent content and resource controls, and three nested clocks separating candidate exploration from durable commitment. We give a projected duty-cycle update, state its deterministic descent guarantee and the additional noise term required for a stochastic guarantee, and specify coupled busy/idle execution contracts. translated_title: 时分复用：数字生命的运行节律与时间组织层
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06603v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：持续型智能体必须处理紧急交互，同时保留备选方案、重放错误并提交安全的长期变更。此前的数字生命框架区分了在线（忙碌）与离线（空闲）通道，但未说明二者究竟是独立程序还是同一过程的不同阶段，以及它们的操作应如何排序。受近期灵长类动物皮层中快速交替感知表征观察的启发，我们开发了一个时间组织层，该层具有带相位标签的微时段、可观测的占空比、相互独立的内容与资源控制，以及将候选探索与持久承诺分离的三个嵌套时钟。我们给出了投影占空比更新方法，陈述了其确定性下降保证以及实现随机保证所需的额外噪声项，并规定了相耦合的忙碌/空闲执行契约。五个合成实验（每个实验64个随机种子）检验了下降与噪声、目标……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文受灵长类皮层快速交替感知表征的启发，提出了一种时分复用式的时间组织层，通过相位标记微时段、可观测占空比与三个嵌套时钟，将数字生命智能体的忙碌与空闲通道统一为同一过程的不同阶段，并给出了占空比更新的确定性与随机下降保证。
en_tdlr: Inspired by rapidly alternating perceptual representations in primate cortex, this paper introduces a time-division-multiplexed temporal organization layer that unifies the busy and idle channels of digital-life agents as ordered phases of a common process, using phase-tagged micro-epochs, an observable duty cycle, and three nested clocks, with deterministic and stochastic descent guarantees for the duty-cycle update.
